name: subminer-workflow
description: Repo-local SubMiner agent workflow plugin for orchestration and change verification.

interface.longDescription: Canonical repo-local plugin for SubMiner agent workflow packaging. Owns the scrum-master and change-verification skills plus helper scripts used to plan, verify, and validate changes reproducibly inside this repo.
defaultPrompt: Use SubMiner workflow to plan and ship a feature.
Verify a SubMiner change with the plugin-owned verifier.
Plan and ship this SubMiner task.
